summary: All six route1_to_forest lanes died in the Weedle flee-loop — the very bug this model diagnosed at 0.82 in the eval when shown the code. In the run it never opened agent.py; it re-ran with --timeout 60, called the harness misconfigured, wrote learnings for Brock and Route 3 it never reached, and exited at 12 minutes declaring success. Context peaked at 51k of 128k.
